item.subject: science
item.stem:
Multiple choice question: During a school garden activity, Meera and her classmates are asked to group the plants and animals they see. Which of the following is a correct way of grouping them ( )
A. Grouping a rose and a hibiscus together because both have red flowers only, and ignoring all other features
B. Grouping a cow, a goat, and a hen together because all are animals that give useful products to people
C. Grouping a mango tree and a cat together because both are tall
D. Grouping a fish and a bird together because both can move fast

options.A: Grouping a rose and a hibiscus together because both have red flowers only, and ignoring all other features
options.B: Grouping a cow, a goat, and a hen together because all are animals that give useful products to people
options.C: Grouping a mango tree and a cat together because both are tall
options.D: Grouping a fish and a bird together because both can move fast
